programs.university: ESIC Business & Marketing School (ESIC Barcelona) — Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV)
programs.type: Affiliated centre of Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV) (private-priced)
programs.degree: Grado en Marketing — docencia en inglés (Graduat/ada en Màrqueting per la URV), preinscription code 71074
programs.language: English (official degree subjects in English; some complementary 'P'/diploma subjects in the ESIC syllabus are listed in Spanish, e.g. 'Habilidades Personales I', 'Modelos de Negocio III' — these belong to ESIC's own add-on diploma, not the grado)
programs.feb_start_evidence: Generalitat Feb-2026 call list: '71074 Màrqueting "ESIC" (docència en Anglès) URV Barcelona U. Públ. CA 16 places, 4.815 € (preu orientatiu febrer, 1r quadrimestre feb-juny)', note 26: B2 English required. NOT in the Feb-2025 list. ESIC's own pages only advertise September starts.
programs.application_deadline: Expected ~2-4 Feb 2027 via accesuniversitat.gencat.cat (Feb 2026 call: 2-4 Feb 2026, assignment 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb). Feb 2027 dates NOT FOUND (not yet published).
programs.application_fee_text: ESIC admission tests (motivation letter, business case, English test) — no fee stated on esic.edu/grados/bachelors-degree-marketing-barcelona or esic.edu/en/degrees/admissions-and-grants. Official preinscription itself has no fee.
programs.deposit_text: ESIC: 'Once you have passed the admission tests, you will receive a pre-enrollment letter. To secure your place, you must pay the reservation and enrollment fees within the period indicated by your advisor.' Amount not published for Barcelona grados (the 2.000 € figure found online is ESIC University Madrid masters — not applicable). For a Feb start the legal place still comes only from the Generalitat preinscription.
programs.refund_text: ESIC Barcelona Guía académica 2022-23 (POSSIBLY OUTDATED): reservation amount is refunded 'a aquellos alumnos internacionales que acrediten que se les ha negado el visado' (proof required). The newer 2024-25 Barcelona guide drops the visa clause and states 'no se devolverán las cantidades pagadas correspondientes a Matrícula, reserva de plaza...' on withdrawal. Get the current visa clause in writing.
programs.tuition_text: esic.edu Barcelona English Marketing page: 'Financial conditions 10.143 € / 10.555 € Price per course. Subject to change' (page shows Sept 2027 start); pathway with extra ESIC diploma 11.000 €/yr, with extra ESIC degree 11.700 €/yr. No separate non-EU surcharge shown. Feb-June (1st 4-month term) indicative price in Feb-2026 call: 4.815 €.
programs.graduate_route: Generalitat rules: completed foreign degree -> homologation/equivalence at the Ministry then preinscription as 'titulat universitari' (5.0 access mark); or (centre-dependent) partial credit recognition: >=30 ECTS recognised -> direct admission to the centre without preinscription; 1-29 ECTS -> preinscription only to that centre with access mark 5. ESIC offers a 'validation plan based on the studies you have taken'. Alternative: foreign secondary diploma homologated/UNEDasiss.
programs.language_requirement: B2 English (Generalitat listing: 'Nivell de llengua anglesa equivalent al B2'; Feb-2026 list note 26: if not accredited before enrolment the centre runs a level test). ESIC accepted certificates: Cambridge First/Advanced/Proficiency, IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC (one search lead quoted IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 95 — not verified on official page). ESIC admission includes its own English test (waived with official certificate).
programs.official_ruct: Yes (per Generalitat Canal Universitats: 'Graduat/ada en Màrqueting per la Universitat Rovira i Virgili'); RUCT code not shown
programs.data_year: Feb place list: Feb 2026 call (2025-26) — POSSIBLY OUTDATED for Feb 2027; tuition shown for 2026-27/2027-28 intake on ESIC page
programs.visa_timing_note: Through the official February preinscription (Feb 2026 pattern: apply 2-4 Feb, places published 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb) no admission letter can exist by early Dec 2026; the Feb 2027 offer list is not yet published (latest on Canal Universitats = Feb 2026). ESIC issues a 'pre-enrollment letter' after its admission tests, which could come earlier, but it is not a legal admission for a Feb start until the Feb preinscription/enrolment. Ask ESIC (admissions Barcelona, +34 93 117 07 84) whether it issues a visa-valid letter for Feb entrants.
programs.risks: Feb places in English appeared only in the Feb-2026 list (not 2025) — may not repeat in 2027. Feb entrants join mid-year (curriculum sequencing unknown). Deposit amount and current visa-refund clause unconfirmed. Price ~10k €/yr.

programs.university: CETT-UB (Escola Universitària d'Hoteleria i Turisme CETT) — Universitat de Barcelona
programs.type: Affiliated centre of Universitat de Barcelona (UB) (private-priced)
programs.language: English (100% English track; bilingual Spanish/Catalan track is code 11011)

programs.application_deadline: Expected ~2-4 Feb 2027 (Feb 2026 call: 2-4 Feb). Feb 2027 dates NOT FOUND (not yet published).
programs.application_fee_text: Official preinscription: no fee found. Credit-recognition route ('study of academic record'): non-refundable 55 € (deducted from enrolment if you enrol).
programs.deposit_text: No deposit described for bachelor preinscription entrants (place assigned by Generalitat, then enrolment). CETT 'seat reservation within one month of admission letter' text found applies to masters. Bachelor deposit NOT FOUND.

programs.graduate_route: CETT: completed foreign degree -> homologation/equivalence at the Ministry, then preinscription; if homologation is denied (except for listed reasons) you may use the 'studies started' route: academic-record study (55 €, resolution in ~3 weeks) for validated credit transfer; favourable resolution allows applying directly to the centre. Generalitat: >=30 ECTS recognised -> direct admission; <30 -> preinscription to that centre only.

programs.data_year: Feb list 2026 call (2025-26) — POSSIBLY OUTDATED for Feb 2027; tuition figure shown on page for Sept 2026 intake with UB fees of 2024/25
programs.visa_timing_note: Through the official February preinscription (Feb 2026 pattern: apply 2-4 Feb, places published 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb) no admission letter can exist by early Dec 2026; the Feb 2027 offer list is not yet published (latest on Canal Universitats = Feb 2026). programs.risks: Field is tourism (not CS/business). Only 10 Feb places. No visa refund/deposit info. Mid-year entry sequencing unknown.

programs.degree: Grau en Empresa, Innovació i Tecnologia (codes 31128 Terrassa presencial, 31127 Terrassa semipresencial, 31125 22@ semipresencial; same rules for Grau en Màrqueting, Innovació i Tecnologia 31131/31133/31134 and double degrees 31130/31136/31137)

programs.application_deadline: Expected ~2-4 Feb 2027 via Generalitat; NOT FOUND for 2027.
programs.application_fee_text: Not stated. Credit-recognition file study ('Estudis d'expedient acadèmic per a la convalidació ...'): 54,54 €.
programs.deposit_text: Price policy 2026-27, §3 Admissió: 'Per formalitzar l'admissió en un grau, la persona interessada haurà de fer un pagament per import de 600 € en concepte de bestreta de la matrícula' via myEUNCET; 'Aquest pagament no garanteix en cap cas l'accés al grau ... cal complir els requisits ... (Accesnet)'.
programs.refund_text: 'No es realitzarà cap reemborsament, ni total ni parcial, d'aquest import, excepte en el cas que la persona candidata no compleixi amb els requisits d'accés.' Visa refusal is not an exception. Enrolment renunciation only in justified cases within the calendar deadline, excluding the 600 € advance.

programs.graduate_route: EUNCET practical info: foreign graduates may request homologation from the Ministry OR partial convalidation directly from the university (never both). >=30 ECTS convalidated (compulsory subjects) -> apply directly to the centre (no preinscription); <30 -> preinscription only to that centre with the convalidation certificate. A Business Computing degree is a plausible match for >=30 ECTS.
programs.language_requirement: EUNCET: no language requirement, 'candidates are advised to have a sufficient level of Spanish, spoken and written'.

notes: KEY RULE: In Catalonia, February entry to an official grado happens only through the Generalitat's extraordinary February preinscription ('places vacants'), covering UB, UAB, UPC, UdL, URV and UVic-UCC and their affiliated centres; UPF, UdG (in 2026) and the private universities (URL incl. La Salle/Esade/IQS/Blanquerna, UIC, UAO CEU) are outside it. Feb 2026 call: apply 2-4 Feb 2026 on accesuniversitat.gencat.cat (up to several preferences), assignment 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb; the Feb 2027 list/dates are NOT yet published (Canal Universitats still shows Feb 2026 as latest) — expect the same pattern (~1st week of Feb 2027). Consequence for the visa: an official admission/enrolment letter cannot exist by early Dec 2026 through this route; only (a) a direct-admission decision via >=30 ECTS credit recognition (centre-by-centre; UVic and FUAB windows found are for Sept only; EUNCET and CETT describe the route without a fixed Feb window) or (b) a private-centre pre-admission/pre-enrollment letter (ESIC, EAE, EUNCET) could come earlier — must be asked explicitly, and these centres warn the place is only legal once the Generalitat assignment/access requirements are met. ENGLISH-TAUGHT Feb-start grados in Catalonia in the Feb 2026 list (label '(docència en anglès)'): ESIC Màrqueting (URV, 16 places, new in 2026), CETT Turisme (UB, 10), FUAB/EUTDH Turisme (UAB, 5), UVic Global Studies (10, includes French as Language B). CETT International Hotel Management (11114) has a 100% English option but the Feb code is shared — confirm. EAE ADE (UdL) is marketed as 'BBA English/bilingual' (11.500 €) but official page says Spanish + bilingual — confirm English group for Feb entrants. No CS/IT grado taught in English has a Feb start in Catalonia (UVic Multimèdia, EUNCET, EUSS are Catalan/Spanish). OUT-OF-GROUP LEADS for coordinator: (1) Feb-2025 list had UPF 41066 'Estudis Globals' with 30 places reserved for students whose secondary studies are from non-EU systems (absent in Feb 2026) — UPF Global Studies is largely English-taught; worth checking with UPF for Feb 2027. (2) UdL Lleida 61054 'Estudis Anglesos' (English Studies, public) had 5 Feb-2026 places. Foreign graduate access (Generalitat page): completed foreign degree -> homologation/equivalence at Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades then 'titulats universitaris' quota (3% of places, access mark 5) — slow; partial convalidation (>=30 ECTS -> direct centre admission, no preinscription; 1-29 -> preinscription only to that centre with mark 5). Several centres (EUNCET, CETT) state foreign graduates may choose convalidation instead of homologation (never simultaneously). Alternatively use foreign secondary diploma (homologation/UNEDasiss). Not verified (sites blocked or search budget exhausted): Esade BBA, IQS, Blanquerna (URL private schools — not in the Generalitat Feb call), GBSB Global Business School and Barcelona Technology School (likely non-official; sites returned 403/525).
